'''Gingal''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who served as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Watch Commander]] at the [[Xyquine base]]. As [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken's]] commanding officer, he was prepared to order a retreat from Xyquine when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces attacked; it was the quick counter order by Cracken that allowed the bulk of the fleet to be saved. This maneuver went on to be named the [[Cracken Twist]].
